free_tier.stated: FOSSVPS is a free 2 vCPU / 4 GiB / 64 GiB VPS gated on a human review of the applicant's open-source work. The provider's own forum posts show a second gate: forum reputation on named boards, with entire communities excluded. 'Nodeseek is no longer an accepted forum for potential new clients. Clients with good non spammy reputations are only accepted from LET or LES. Registration via a VPN is blocked. Throw away email addresses are blocked. Registering from Russia, China or North Korea is blocked.' And on the abuse that caused it: '29th of May VPS's belonging to NodeSeek clients will be terminated with no records kept.'

record.interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
record.chaining: The per-node sponsor dates are the composition rule: a box on buc2 expired 2026-10-17 and a rebuild to another node destroys the data, so this is a place to run a workload and not a place to keep state.

limits.value: The gate is a reputation held on one of two named forums plus a country the operator will accept, so an applicant with no LET or LES history and a blocked country cannot enter at all, whatever their open-source work.

record.provider: kts24 — 1 tb storage vps free for 3 months (ceph beta)

free_tier.stated: 1000 GB storage on an unmanaged VPS with 1 vCore, 2 GB memory and 2 TB traffic per month, free of charge for at least 3 months; EUR 8.99 per month after the 3 months. A test offer posted in March 2022 in a discussion that is now closed
free_tier.notes: a March 2022 test offer in a LowEndSpirit thread that is now closed; trial servers expire at the end of the trial unless extended

identity_cost.detail: the March 2022 test needed an account at the provider's panel and a request e-mail sent from the registered address; no card was asked for in the offer text. The offer is closed

record.reliability_note: Promotional offer of 1 TB storage VPS free for 3 months with no card required dates to March 2022. The series was not launched publicly.
record.confidence_note: Rejection quoted from historical research records; unverified against live endpoints.
